page: Microsoft Azure E16ps_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the 64-bit ARM architecture and running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance provides 16 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8 GB per core ratio designed to address memory-intensive computational tasks.

Storage configuration on the E16ps_v7 is stateless, featuring no bundled local storage disks. Storage operations require external network-attached volumes, with compatibility for Azure Premium Storage tiers. The instance includes no GPU acceleration hardware and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:8 processor-to-memory configuration delivers high memory density while leveraging the power and operational efficiency of modern ARM architecture. Because it operates on ARM64 processors, binary compatibility requires ARM-compiled applications or runtime environments. The hardware profile suits distributed in-memory caches, relational and NoSQL databases, memory-bound enterprise applications, and large-scale data engineering workloads.
